system.description:
You coat yourself in a Protective aura of chakra, protecting you from damage. When you cast this jutsu, you lose the benefits of any Armor you are wearing, utilizing this Jutsu’s AC calculation for its duration.

Your AC becomes 13 + your Intelligence Modifier + Half of your proficiency Bonus. This jutsu ends if you dismiss it as a Bonus action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you gain 8 Temporary hit points, which can be replenished as a Bonus action on your turn. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the AC this Jutsu grants by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the AC this Jutsu grants by +2, instead of +1.
